snippet.title: It Takes a War Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Out Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3919530
Play the Demo! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4048280
Sign up to the newsletter: https://www.pantaloon.io/

From the creator of THE CORRIDOR comes It Takes a War - a team-based shooter with VISCERAL gunplay and RELENTLESS action. Throw yourself into RELENTLESSLY VISCERAL combat where survival is entirely dependent on communication.

There is no 'i' in 'team', but there is in VICTORY!
